commit.message:
fix(sim): judge a cross drill's first rapid from the turret index position

On a lathe or a mill-turn, the cross drill had no first-traverse law.
The lathe post positions C, then sends X and Z in one G00 from the
turret's index position (the top of the X and Z travel). That rapid
can pass every radius from the first point out, at every height from
it up. The new law `verify::live_first_traverse` reads the stock, the
parts, the chuck and the tailstock revolved about the spindle in that
band, and the cross branch refuses the drill by name when one reaches
it. A mill-turn cross drill also answers to the upright law of its
default mill post. The cross drill's stamp takes one more word.

Fixes #3077

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(sim): export LiveSolids beside the live-tool law

Refs #3077

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(sim): read the work and the chuck in the station slab, not revolved

The revolved reading refused every legal cross drill on a square bar
or a box stock: C stands at its angle before X and Z move, so the work
and the turning steel are read in the station's slab, each facet
clipped by its four planes. The fixed steel stays revolved.

Refs #3077

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(sim): read the cross drill's first traverse with the tool's stack, let a touch pass

The lathe post's first G00 X Z goes to the end of move 0 (the R-plane
point). The swept solid follows the flute, shank and holder bands, a
face flush with the first point passes, and a coarse model's excess
grows the work.

Refs #3077

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(sim): the cross drill's first traverse follows the #1053 excess law

The model excess tightens the touch tolerance while one is left; past
that the law reads the facets untightened, as every other cross-drill
law does.

Refs #3077

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(app): judge the mill kinds' first traverse on a mill-turn

A mill-turn posts a milling tool through the mill post (Z to the
clearance, then X/Y), so its planar, 3-D, hole and multi-axis kinds now
answer to the same first-traverse laws as on a mill
(first_traverse::mill_order). A rotary kind on a mill-turn (a radial
live tool on the spindle C) stays out; #3096 owns it. The struck-link
planner and the mesh steel stay mill-only (decision #3083). Mill-turn
caches of the judged kinds read Stale once (stamp word
first-traverse-mill-turn-3083).

Fixes #3083

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(app): raise the cross recognition case's clearance clear of its box stock

The 44 box stock stands out to X 22 from Z 0 up; at clearance 20 the
first hole's R plane is at radius 20, so the lathe post's first rapid
comes down through 2 mm of uncut stock. Clearance 30 puts it outside.

Fixes #3077
